description:
## Goal

Make `InputDemand(F)` one ordinary reactive per-function fact and delete its private whole-cone calculation. The atomic value continues to carry local dispatch, forwarded dispatch, and the exact returned relation; `fz-kdt.165` later adds callable identity as a fourth dimension of this same fact.

## Current defect

`derive_input_demand` collects a private forwarding cone and invokes a private fixpoint for forwarded dispatch and returned positions. The returned calculation also subtracts values supplied by recursion only within one function. A mutual component can therefore look unsupplied and mint unbought activation keys: the recorded corpus signal was 79 keys with no distinct return versus 36 that bought one, concentrated in the `List.reduce_*` mutual cycle.

The calculation repeats graph discovery for every requested function and owns a scheduler-within-the-scheduler. It is separate from executable `RuntimeDemand`: `InputDemand` decides semantic activation-key precision per source function, while `RuntimeDemand(E)` decides materialization needs per executable.

## Prerequisites

- `fz-kdt.214` publishes the one normalized typed path relation for local inputs, exact callsites/results, returns, protocol forwarding, and callable-use sinks.
- `fz-kdt.200` replaces coarse `Whole` demand with the final typed question-axis domain and defines its pullback through that relation.

This ticket must build reactive formulas once over those final authorities; it must not retain a coarse compatibility lattice or a second relation.

## Correct model

- One `FactKey::InputDemand(F)` and one World slot hold the complete atomic value.
- One per-function formula reads only `InputFlow(F)`, exact peer `InputDemand` values, and `CallGraphComponent` facts.
- Forwarded dispatch follows every reachable call argument. Returned dependence composes exact caller argument, callee input-to-result, and callsite result-to-caller-sink mappings without crossing path coordinate systems.
- Source-owned contributions are replaceable, so edits retract only obsolete source edges.
- Mutual recursion converges through ordinary fact movement. Supplied-position subtraction joins across the whole recursive component instead of running a self-only mini-fixpoint.
- A publication commits every dimension together; readers can never observe a half-old, half-new keying decision.
- Equal conclusions retain the existing allocation/generation and wake nobody.

## TDD

1. Acyclic forwarding evaluates only exact readers and publishes all current dimensions atomically.
2. Self and mutual recursion converge independent of job order with no waits on cyclic peer values.
3. The 79 recorded unbought returned-axis splits fall while the 36 bought distinctions and every activation-keying law remain.
4. Direct, delivered, reconstructed, projected, protocol, map/list/tuple, and exact result-field flows from `InputFlow` reach the same fact.
5. Two same-callee callsites and swapped/projected result fields remain isolated.
6. Edge replacement retracts stale demand without resetting unaffected functions.
7. Cross-process fact/work multisets, activation keys, artifacts, and all target outputs are exact.

## Required deletion

- the private cone collection and graph state;
- all private Kleene/SCC rounds in `derive_input_demand`;
- the self-only returned-supply fixpoint;
- dimension-specific forwarding scans, shadow facts, compatibility bridges, and migration telemetry.

## Acceptance

No cone, root, function-inventory, or repeated full-graph scan remains. Every non-initial evaluation names exact changed content. No formula waits on a cyclic peer’s finality. Equal conclusions do not replace the value, advance generation, or wake readers. Full focused keying/recursion/incremental tests, serial library, serial fixture matrix, three-door behavior, causal determinism, formatting, documentation checks, `cargo check`, and strict clippy pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final diff before its one commit and close.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and its build/2 gate names this ticket as its removal owner, so the split is recorded as a PIN rather than blessed as a law. Measured at the landing: of the executables 199 adds, 36 buy a distinct return and 91 do not (83 on the cold review's 597-fixture comparand). Top offenders: List.reduce_cont/3 (21), List.reduce_while_cont/3 (18), Range.reduce_while_cont/6 (9), reduce_while_step/3 (6) -- all the mutual reduce cycle the self-only subtraction cannot see. Red-first for you: those fall while the 36 bought ones and every ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS row hold, and quicksort stays at 17.

title: Replace InputDemand cone replay with one reactive per-function fact
